reason: I do one big shop a week with a mental list and it works for me. I would not hand my family's receipts to an app, and a promise that it is never sold does not change that for me.
objection: I don't trust an app with my family's data, and snapping every receipt is one more chore in my week.
would_change_my_mind: Seeing that people I know use it and trust it, plus a way to use it without scanning receipts or sharing anything about my household.
